Name: Nike Pegasus Plus
Description: The Nike Pegasus Plus is a high-performance running shoe designed to provide excellent cushioning and support for everyday runs. Featuring Flyknit upper for breathability and ZoomX foam midsole for responsive cushioning, it offers a smooth, energizing ride with every step. The high-abrasion rubber outsole ensures durability and traction, while the midfoot band keeps your foot secure during your run.
Benefits: Flyknit upper with perforations for reduced weight and enhanced breathability.
ZoomX foam midsole for responsive, springy cushioning and energy return.
High-abrasion rubber outsole for durability and superior traction.

Product Details.Intended Use: Not intended for use as Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)

Name: Nike InfinityRN 4
Description: The Nike InfinityRN 4 delivers maximum cushioning for elevated comfort during everyday runs. It features a rocker-shaped platform with ReactX foam in the midsole, providing a soft and responsive feel. The updated Flyknit upper and water-resistant membrane keep you dry, while the ultra-comfortable collar and tongue provide a snug fit. The new ReactX foam and wider toe box enhance the overall comfort and performance of this version.
Benefits: Updated Flyknit upper with water-resistant membrane to keep you dry.
New ReactX foam in the midsole for extra cushioning and comfort.
Waffle outsole for durable traction, perfect for road running.

Product Details.Intended Use: Not intended for use as Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)

Name: Nike Pegasus Trail 5
Description: The Nike Pegasus Trail 5 is designed to conquer both dirt trails and paved roads with its ultra-responsive ReactX foam midsole. This versatile shoe combines cushioning with breathability, featuring mesh uppers for ventilation and Flywire technology for a secure fit. The outsole is designed for all-direction traction, providing grip on technical trails while ensuring a smooth transition to the road. Reflective details offer visibility during low-light conditions.
Benefits: Nike ReactX foam midsole provides extra cushioning for enhanced comfort.
Breathable mesh upper with Flywire technology offers a secure and ventilated fit.
Generative traction pattern and rubber forefoot for all-direction grip on trails and roads.

Product Details.Intended Use: Not intended for use as Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)

Name: Men's Fila Racer Energized
Description: The Men's Fila Racer Energized is built for comfort and durability, making it an excellent choice for daily runs. Its cushioned platform absorbs impact, while the heavy-duty bottom tread provides superior traction. The durable leather and mesh upper ensure breathability and long-lasting performance, rain or shine.
Benefits: Cushioned platform for enhanced comfort and impact absorption.
Heavy-duty bottom tread offers excellent traction on various surfaces.
Durable leather and mesh upper for breathability and weather resistance.

Name: Adizero SL2 Running Shoes
Description: The Adizero SL2 Running Shoes are lightweight and designed for speed, making them perfect for breaking personal records. Featuring responsive Lightstrike Pro cushioning for exceptional energy return and an engineered mesh upper for targeted support and breathability, these shoes keep you comfortable and fast. Made with at least 20% recycled materials, they are part of Adidas' commitment to reducing waste and environmental impact.
Benefits: Lightstrike Pro cushioning delivers energy return for next-level speed.
Engineered mesh upper provides breathability and targeted support.
Made with at least 20% recycled materials to reduce waste and environmental footprint.

Product Details.Color: Cobalt Blue / Lucid Lemon / Blue Spark

Name: Nike Air Force 1 '07
Description: The Nike Air Force 1 '07 brings a fresh spin on the legendary b-ball OG, combining classic design with modern style. Featuring durable stitched overlays, clean finishes, and Nike Air cushioning, these shoes offer both heritage and comfort. The low-cut silhouette and padded collar add to the sleek look and plush feel, making them perfect for all-day wear.
Benefits: Stitched overlays add durability, heritage style, and support.
Nike Air cushioning provides lightweight, all-day comfort.
Low-cut silhouette for a streamlined, classic look.
Air Force 1 Origins: Debuting in 1982, the AF1 was the first basketball shoe to feature Nike Air, revolutionizing the sneaker game. It has since become a cultural icon while maintaining the soft, springy cushioning that made it legendary.

Name: Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Cement Grey'
Description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Cement Grey' combines timeless style with modern comfort. Featuring high-quality leather in the upper with the iconic elephant print texture, it offers durability and a premium feel. The visible Nike Air unit in the sole provides street-ready cushioning, making it a standout choice for everyday wear.
Benefits: Genuine and synthetic leathers deliver a durable and supportive fit.
Foam midsole with Air-Sole units in the heel and forefoot ensures superior cushioning.
Rubber outsole offers long-lasting durability and traction.

Description: The Men's Sanati SL combines relaxed style with premium craftsmanship. Featuring a durable and breathable Italian leather upper with front perforations, it delivers comfort and sophistication. Its chunky outsole adds a modern touch to the classic silhouette, making it a versatile option for leisure and style-conscious wearers.
Benefits: Premium Italian leather and suede construction for durability and elegance.
Breathable perforations for enhanced comfort during extended wear.
Chunky outsole offers a modern twist on a classic design.

Classic wing tip vamp and golf shoe detailing for elevated style.

Name: Men's Targa NT
Description: The Men's Targa NT is a streetwear staple that combines retro-revival design with modern comfort. Featuring a leather upper and iconic heritage styling, this leisure shoe delivers a bold and timeless look perfect for casual outings. Its durable construction ensures long-lasting wear, making it an essential addition to your wardrobe.
Benefits: Premium leather and synthetic upper for durability and style.
Iconic heritage design embraces retro streetwear fashion.
Comfortable fit for everyday wear.

Name: Rivalry Low Shoes
Description: The Rivalry Low Shoes bring back the prestigious '80s basketball trainer with a modern twist for daily life. Originally popular on the court and later embraced by punks and skaters, this iconic sneaker features a soft leather and synthetic leather upper, terry lining for added comfort, and a durable rubber cupsole. Perfect for anyone looking to add '80s nostalgia to their everyday wardrobe.
Benefits: Soft leather and synthetic leather upper for durability and style.
Terry lining adds a layer of comfort for all-day wear.
Rubber cupsole offers excellent grip and durability.

Name: Nike Lunar Force 1
Description: The Nike Lunar Force 1 reimagines the iconic AF1 for cold, wet weather. Featuring water-repellent leather and a rugged outsole, it offers both style and functionality for challenging conditions. With mountain boot-inspired hardware, an oversized tongue, and durable star-studded design details, the Lunar Force 1 is built to keep you looking sharp and staying comfortable when the elements hit.
Benefits: Water-repellent leather upper provides durability and easy cleaning.
Aggressive traction pattern on the rubber outsole enhances grip and durability.
Tongue wraps over the ankle to keep out moisture and cold, ensuring warmth and dryness.

Name: Nike SFB Gen 2 8”
Description: The Nike SFB Gen 2 8” is a lightweight and durable tactical boot designed for speed, flexibility, and protection over rough terrain. Constructed with nylon canvas and synthetic leather, it offers breathability and durability. Featuring an aggressive traction pattern, internal rock shield, and Nike Free-inspired outsole, it provides multi-surface grip and natural movement, making it ideal for challenging environments.
Benefits: Durable nylon canvas and polishable synthetic leather for breathability and long-lasting wear.
Internal rock shield helps prevent punctures and reduces pressure on rugged terrain.
Rubber outsole with reinforced heel strike zone ensures grip and durability on various surfaces.

Special Features: Dual-zone lacing with durable webbing for a locked-in fit.
Metal screen vents on the medial side for cooling.
Shallow flex grooves to prevent debris buildup.

SFB Origins: The SFB collection pays tribute to Nike co-founder Bill Bowerman and his WWII service. Drawing from his legacy, the SFB series combines field-proven durability with innovative athletic design.

Name: Men's Chastizer Boot
Description: The Men's Chastizer Boot is designed for the toughest jobs, offering a durable and comfortable solution for demanding work environments. With a high-top silhouette made from a blend of leather, synthetics, and mesh, it ensures long-lasting wear and breathability. The EVA midsole and memory foam cushioning provide exceptional comfort, while the instep zipper closure and rubber toe cap enhance functionality and protection.
Benefits: High ankle support and instep zipper closure ensure a secure fit and ease of wear.
Soft memory foam cushioning provides all-day comfort during strenuous tasks.
Durable leather, synthetic, and mesh construction for breathability and long-lasting performance.
